rss_measurement.scope: peak_rss_bytes is the climb dbt parse. injector_peak_rss_bytes is a separate Python process that loads the other manifests and writes the external-node payload. baseline.peak_rss_bytes is the highest of the per-source stubbed parses. Each timed command is one process.

injection_policy_note: Injected nodes are real models, seeds, and snapshots with access public. Seeds and snapshots use config.access when the node has no access. Protected and private nodes are omitted. depends_on edges are kept only when the target is also injected. ref_filtered_* is recorded and was not applied to the timed parse.

previous_inject_all.note: Headline figures from the prior scale run on this branch, which injected every real model. These fixtures marked every model access public, so the injected node count matched the public count.

previous_public_only.note: Headline figures from the public-only scale run on this branch before the fixtures gained public seeds, snapshots and the installed-package control. Its machine was not recorded.

not_measured: Git pack transfer and the product disk-eviction counters. This probe does not start the loopback Git server or the source-fetch pool. checkout_bytes is the materialized project tree.
Concurrent parse RSS. The large-org profile compiles with concurrency 4. These parses are serial, so peak_rss_bytes is one dbt process.
